meta.name: video-outpainting
meta.description: Video outpainting on RunComfy via the `runcomfy` CLI — extend the spatial canvas of a video, change aspect ratio (9:16 vertical to 16:9 horizontal or vice versa), add environment beyond the original frame while preserving the central action. Routes prompt-shaped spatial extension through Wan 2-7 edit-video and points the agent at dedicated ComfyUI outpaint workflows when seam quality matters for hero delivery. Triggers on "video outpaint", "video outpainting", "extend video canvas", "expand video frame", "uncrop video", "aspect ratio change", "vertical to horizontal video", "16:9 from 9:16", "TikTok to YouTube", or any explicit ask to extend a video spatially beyond its original frame.

copy.tagline: 扩展视频画面空间，改变视频宽高比
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想把竖屏视频转为横屏或反之，同时保留主体动作
copy.tagline_en: Extend video canvas and change aspect ratio
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to convert vertical video to horizontal or vice versa while preserving the main action

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能通过 RunComfy 的 CLI 扩展视频画面：改变宽高比（如竖屏变横屏），在保持中心动作的同时添加周围环境。
howto.when: 当你提到“视频扩图”、“改变宽高比”、“竖屏转横屏”等关键词，或明确要求扩展视频画面时触发。

say.text: 把这个竖屏视频扩成横屏16:9。
say.note: Claude 会调用 Wan 2-7 模型扩展画面。

say.text: 给这段视频左右各加30%的背景。
say.note: Claude 会按提示扩展视频画布。
Claude 会推荐使用 ComfyUI 工作流处理。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can extend a video's spatial canvas via RunComfy's CLI: change aspect ratio (e.g., vertical to horizontal), add environment beyond the original frame while preserving the central action.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention keywords like "video outpaint", "aspect ratio change", "vertical to horizontal", or explicitly ask to extend a video's canvas.

say_en.text: Extend this vertical video to 16:9 horizontal.
say_en.note: Claude will use Wan 2-7 model to expand the canvas.

say_en.text: Add 30% background to the left and right of this clip.
say_en.note: Claude will extend the video canvas as prompted.
Claude will recommend a ComfyUI workflow for better seam quality.
